content: In case the I-PDU is buffered in the PDU Router module: The PDU Router module shall copy the data of the I-PDU up to smallest of the following values: • the received data length ( PduLength of received I-PDU) • the configured maximum PduLength in the buffer PduRPduMaxLength . In this case the rest of the received I-PDU shall be dropped.

In case the I-PDU is buffered in the PDU Router module: The PDU Router module shall copy the data of the I-PDU up to smallest of the following values: • the received data length ( PduLength of received I-PDU) • the configured length of the destination I-PDU. In this case the rest of the received I-PDU shall be dropped.
